chunks: Think not that God would go back on His promise (made) to the apostles. Indeed God is mighty, the Lord of retribution.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's promise to the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a cornerstone for the doctrine of divine justice (Adl), affirming that Allah’s promise to the prophets is inextricably linked to the ultimate triumph of truth over falsehood, a theme central to the Imams' struggle against oppression. It underscores that divine retribution is not merely punitive but a fulfillment of the covenant, ensuring that the legacy of the messengers remains unbroken and victorious in the eyes of the faithful.
